description: This PHP source file defines a class 'registry_v3_1' that extends 'registry_v3' and handles registration of service functions and data types for a web service API related to SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It includes methods for registering SOAP functions, complex types, and structures used in the web service, such as module lists, ACLs, entry results, and link structures.

classes.name: registry_v3_1
classes.description: A class extending registry_v3, responsible for registering web service functions and data types specific to version 3.1 of the API.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers various API functions related to retrieving entries, searching modules, and fetching module metadata.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Defines and registers complex data types used in the web service API, such as result structures and module lists.
